articles.title: Voter Guide Meet the Judicial Candidates on the Nov Ballot
articles.excerpt: Meyer is an attorney, a retired Houston firefighter and a registered nurse who lives in Montgomery (San Antonio Report).

articles.title: Texas Supreme Court Criminal Appeals Results Elections
articles.excerpt: Meyer won the race for Fifteenth Court of Appeals, Place 3 with 4,950,446 votes (51.5%); opponent: April Farris (R) 4,654,820 (48.5%), in unofficial returns (Texas Secretary of State; The Texas Tribune).
